symbols.name: SampleStatistics
symbols.summary: Selects sample quantiles without interpolating or converting actual observations.
symbols.remarks: Callers own sample retention, ascending ordering and the meaning of an empty observation window.

symbols.name: NearestRank(IReadOnlyList, double)
symbols.summary: Selects a nearest-rank quantile from nonempty, ascending observations.
symbols.remarks: This method does not sort, copy or validate the ordering. Nearest-rank p50 can differ from a midpoint median.

syntax.content: public static T NearestRank(IReadOnlyList sortedValues, double quantile)

parameters.description: Observations already ordered ascending and stable for this call.
The finite fraction from zero through one; zero selects the first observation.

returns.description: The actual observation at rank ceil(count multiplied by quantile), with a minimum rank of one.
